pv.reason.native_fact_unknown.description: the profile supplied no value for this fact; an unknown fact is published as absence and never as zero

pv.reason.value_outside_pack_range.description: the decoded value lies outside the pack's published bounds; it is never clamped

pv.reason.input_presence_unknown.description: a pair of zero words does not show that the input exists; input membership is not guessed and the zero stays native evidence

pv.reason.negative_active_power_sign_unk.description: the contract states the sign only while producing; the negative range is Unknown and no value is published with an assumed sign

pv.reason.state_code_not_observed.description: only the observed status code has a symbol; every other code is Unknown and its raw word stays native evidence

pv.reason.power_group_refused.description: the family refused the power group with an exception and the cause is Unknown; per-inverter power is Unknown, not zero

pv.reason.period_counter_time_domain_not.description: the pack's generated-energy fact is a lifetime counter; the period boundary and the time domain of this counter are Unknown

pv.reason.field_not_consumed_by_profile.description: the pack could carry this quantity, but the admitted profile does not decode it; the words stay native evidence until a profile admits them

pv.reason.battery_outside_pv_family.description: battery values are not PV facts; they are withheld here and governed by the storage gate

pv.reason.meter_outside_pv_family.description: meter values are not PV facts; they are Unknown and governed by the gateway-meter gate

pv.reason.state_and_alarm_meanings_unkno.description: the status words are bit fields whose meanings are Unknown, and one of them is derived from a serial number and is never published

pv.reason.no_defined_input_beyond_eighth.description: the contract defines eight string inputs; the words past them are not facts

pv.reason.no_pack_fact_for_dc_input_ener.description: the pack defines no DC-input energy fact; the counter stays native evidence

pv.reason.statistics_time_domain_unresol.description: the device statistics time lay in local time rather than UTC in one reading per unit; it is never used as a sample time
